Chapter 966  Chapter 23 Inner Universe (Please Subscribe)_2

The metamorphosis of life is beneficial for the Chaos Void, which is why the Origin Source descends upon it.

However, for the universe, stepping out of the River of Space-Time permanently seizes part of the universe's resources, thus causing backlash originating from the universe and the River of Space-Time.

...

"What's happening? Why do I feel such a heaviness in my heart?"

"Yes, it's like a great disaster is impending."

"Has something changed?"

In the Cosmic Starry Skies, the vast majority of beings are unaware of Lin Yuan's ultimate ascension fluctuations, but the million-light-year rift torn open within the universe and the massive pressure of the Chaos Void Origin still affect the inhabitants of the universe.

At this moment, every life form feels an immense pressure as if the heavens and earth are about to collapse.

A few mighty beings of the tenth and eleventh layers, extremely sensitive to space, faintly realize someone is attempting the ultimate ascension, and such an impact could only be by the unprecedented Galaxy Master.

"Is the Galaxy Master attempting the ultimate ascension?"

"Attempting the ultimate ascension, could it be that even the Galaxy Master needs to attempt it?"

"I wonder if the Galaxy Master will be able to smoothly step into the twelfth layer."

"Even before attempting the ultimate ascension, the Galaxy Master has already surpassed those of the twelfth layer, what will happen once the ascension succeeds... that..."

Many mighty beings of the tenth and eleventh layers have their scalps tingling, yet most of them still look forward with anticipation, and these beings are primarily from various powerful and ordinary clans.

Even without the Galaxy Master, they would have to submit to the powerful peak clans and fight fiercely for them.

With the Galaxy Master becoming the ultimate, human civilization would become unprecedentedly strong, and at most, they would submit to human civilization.

It might even be better, as with the guidance of human civilization, they may not need to fight against those peak clans.

...

Robber Clan territory.

A mysterious and unknowable place.

In front of an unremarkable wooden house, the Ultimate Robber Clan member sits, gazing distantly at the scene of the Galaxy Major attempting the ultimate ascension.

"As expected of the reincarnation of a Great Saint from another era, merely attempting the twelfth layer causes such a great commotion." The Ultimate Robber Clan member outside the wooden house reflects, "After the reincarnation of a Great Saint, memories are generally shrouded, and typically, most memories will recover after attempting the ultimate ascension."

"A Great Saint who recovers most of his memories, will return to his peak form at the fastest speed."

"The reincarnation of a Great Saint... In the countless universes of the Chaos Void, the chances of encountering a reincarnation of a Great Saint are extremely slim, yet we came across one?"

The Ultimate Robber Clan member inside the wooden house also feels this is unbelievable.

"Hahahaha, lucky that my Robber Clan did not oppose the Galaxy Master, else once this Great Saint recovers his strength, even if we hide within the universe, it won't be easy for us."

The size of the universe itself equals a normal Chaos Realm being, and a Great Saint? Even if he cannot completely destroy a universe, he can easily cause universes to repeatedly 'reboot'.

With too many reboots, even hiding Robber Clan members can't withstand it, let alone between the great destruction and rebirth of the universe, if a Great Saint is willing to pay the price, he could influence what's inside the universe.

...

In the deep layers of cosmic space-time, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

A six-armed figure also notices the changes in the universe.

"Has the master begun attempting the ultimate ascension?" As the 'spirit' of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, the six-armed figure can observe many external information through the realm itself.

"Discerning the Seventh Realm of space-time, nurturing the Chaos Rule...the master's foundation should be more than just this." The six-armed figure looks distantly at the million-light-year cosmic rift, quietly thinking.

Whether it's the Seventh Realm of space-time or the Chaos Rule, it's merely a perception, an enhancement of one's own foundation, even combined, it's impossible to tear open a million-light-year cosmic rift.

"Your Majesty, have you reincarnated?"

The six-armed figure murmurs to itself, His Majesty Xuanhuang, as a Chaos Great Saint and of those a Legendary Great Saint, has the opportunity of reincarnation.

Normally, beings of the Chaos Realm have the ability to reincarnate.

However, normally in the Chaos Realm, there are no memories retained prior to reaching the twelfth layer after reincarnation.

Through reincarnation, cleansing all physical, bloodline, Divine Skills, and talent traits, in addition to having no memories.

Reaching the twelfth layer again is highly unlikely, akin to a fool's dream, thus the end of a normal Chaos Realm reincarnation is essentially no different from death.

However, Chaos Great Saints and Legendary Great Saints can retain a small portion of fragmented memories after reincarnating.

A small fraction of fragmented memories from a Chaos Great Saint or even a Legendary Great Saint is incredibly precious? It significantly increases the likelihood of returning to the twelfth layer.

...

Underneath the million-light-year cosmic rift.

Lin Yuan sits cross-legged, looking up.

"A million light-years..." Lin Yuan is shocked internally, the extent of this rift almost approaches the peak of the Path Splitting Realm's internal universe.

"Here it comes."

Before Lin Yuan could contemplate further, the terrifying Chaos Void Origin, flowing through a million light-year cosmic fissure, poured in mightily.

"I absorb, I absorb, I absorb."

Lin Yuan allowed the universe inside his body to devour the Chaos Void Origin as much as possible, his physical body and soul did the same, and so did both of his Primordial Spirits.

The Chaos Void Origin is the purest energy of the Chaos Void, far surpassing the chaos stones, and offers countless benefits to any life form.

Whoosh whoosh.

Accompanied by a frenzied devouring of the Chaos Void Origin.

The universe inside Lin Yuan's body began to expand wildly again.

Twenty light-years.

Fifty light-years.

One hundred light-years.

One thousand light-years.

...

After more than two hundred breaths.

The universe inside Lin Yuan's body had already surged to ten thousand light-years.

"Ten thousand light years?"

Lin Yuan found it hard to believe; he had already reached the minimum threshold for an inner universe.

Normally, advancing from the eleventh to the twelfth tier, if successful, would grow the inner universe to a range from tens of thousands to one hundred thousand light-years within a short time.

This duration would generally take a few thousand years.

Newly advanced twelfth-tier beings fully stabilize their realm by completely absorbing the infused Chaos Void Origin, reaching the highest tier.

But now?

Lin Yuan had reached it before even the Chaos Void Origin Infusion was finished?

"My inner world... no, it should now be referred to as an inner universe..." Lin Yuan felt the vast breath of the inner universe, thinking rapidly in his mind.

The Chaos Void Origin infusion continued to persist relentlessly.

Two hundred fifty breaths.

Three hundred breaths.

Three hundred thirty breaths.

Until the very last three hundred thirty-three breaths.

The Chaos Void Origin infusion abruptly stopped.

At this moment.

The universe within Lin Yuan's body had already exceeded one hundred thousand light-years, reaching a circumference of one hundred eighty thousand light-years.

You must understand, at the eleventh tier during the push to the twelfth tier, the inner world would expand quickly, just managing to reach ten light-years after carrying all the Chaos Void Origin.

Then, it would begin the ultimate leap. During this period, the inner world would rapidly absorb and devour the settled Chaos Void Origin, swelling quickly until reaching ten thousand light-years and transforming into an inner universe.

In the end, it leveraged the power of the inner universe to completely succeed in the ultimate leap into the twelfth tier.

Simply put, when progressing from the eleventh to the twelfth tier, two actions are necessary.

One is to withstand and counteract the backlash of the River of Space-Time and the universe.

The other is to guide the transformation of the inner world into an inner universe.

Failure to achieve either would lead to a failed ultimate progression.

But now, Lin Yuan's inner world reaching a circumference of one hundred eighty thousand light-years, had already reached the scope of an inner universe.

The threshold for an inner universe is ten thousand light-years; Lin Yuan has one hundred eighty thousand light-years, far exceeding the scope of an inner universe.

...

The rapid expansion of the inner world caused Lin Yuan to transform it into an inner universe even before making the ultimate leap.

In other words.

The two major difficulties of the ultimate challenge were virtually reduced to one for Lin Yuan.

"The size of the inner universe is still rapidly increasing..."

Lin Yuan gazed down at his inner universe nearing two hundred thousand light-years. After the end of the Chaos Void Origin Infusion, the expansion of the inner universe did not stop but accelerated even more,

Instantly exceeding five hundred thousand light-years.

"My current strength..." Lin Yuan's heart stirred slightly; he was only halfway through the ultimate challenge and already felt his combat power reaching and even surpassing the peak of the Path Splitting Realm.
